expected_results: A value-blind 7-status mailbox OAuth health model (HEALTHY / TRANSIENT_FAILURE / DEGRADED / RECONSENT_REQUIRED / SECURITY_CONFIGURATION_ERROR / SYNCHRONIZER_STALLED / UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED) derived purely from the secret-free health.mailbox_health dicts, with alert severity against the Phase-3 thresholds (3 consecutive -> WARNING; 15m -> DEGRADED; 60m -> CRITICAL; invalid_grant/401/403 -> RECONSENT_REQUIRED/CRITICAL immediately; stall -> CRITICAL; no-new-mail -> no alert) and a pure decide_alert with dedup/cooldown/exactly-once-recovery.

An operator surface: a staff-only, DARK-gated endpoint (operator/mailbox-health/), an ADR-0035 operational-health probe (mailbox_ingest), a DARK-timer alert signal via broker_mailbox_health --oauth-health/--exit-nonzero-on-reconsent/--exit-nonzero-on-synchronizer-stalled, and an Operations-console page; plus a truthful, additive owner banner derived from the existing owner-scoped /mailboxes/status/ payload that never zeroes the withdrawal cards.

Strictly additive + migration-free + value-blind: no token/credential/cursor/email-body/full-address in any output; no model write, no cursor mutation, no withdrawal create/correlate, no reconnect; DARK by default; ADR-0090 (ref-less Vantage manual-review) and ADR-0092 (staff-gated correlation) preserved; correlation scheduling assessed and deferred (no schedule added).

limitations: Repository-only and DARK. The operator endpoint (BROKER_MAILBOX_OPERATOR_HEALTH_ENABLED) and the alert-delivery timer (ops/monitoring/guvfx-broker-mailbox-health.*) are NOT enabled; alert DELIVERY (OnFailure notifier / a durable alert store) is NOT wired by this packet. decide_alert is a pure function; persisting the prev-alert snapshot is the (deferred) delivery layer's job.

No production run, no live mailbox, no Google Cloud Console read/verification, no publishing-status change. The 7-day Testing-mode mechanism is labelled VERIFIED (Google's documented behaviour) vs HIGH-CONFIDENCE INFERENCE (that THIS project is in Testing) per the checklist; it is NOT confirmed from the console by this packet.
